status_line: A happy Search API customer that went over its commit three months in a row. The Research API trial passed. The $120K expansion is with procurement and needs a security questionnaire before it reaches the CFO.

opportunity.detail: Research API expansion. $9 per 1,000 calls on a $120K annual commit. Order form sent 10/6. Search API overage bills on top.

top_of_mind.text: Research API trial scored 87% correct on their 200-question test set. Target in the plan is 90% at go-live.
Elena agreed to $9 per 1,000 calls if the commit starts Dec 1.
Order form sent to Ravi Mehta in procurement.
Ravi will not send the form to the CFO until our security questionnaire is back. It has 64 questions.
Their budget year ends Nov 30. If we miss Nov 20, the deal moves to next year's budget.

blockers.detail: 64 questions. Leo has 41 answered. Data retention and log access are the hard ones.

blockers.title: 87% is short of 90%.

blockers.title: Budget year ends Nov 30.

business_map.context: Northwind Analytics sells market data and analyst reports to retail and travel brands. About 1,400 staff. Four units buy data tools on their own budgets. We are live in one and have a deal open in a second.

units.name: Analyst Reports
units.what: Writes paid market reports for retail and travel clients. About 60 analysts.
units.search: Research API drafts the first pass of each report with sources. Analysts check and finish it.
units.incumbent: Manual research. Quarry Search was in the bake-off.

units.name: Pricing Intelligence
units.what: Tracks retail prices across the web for their pricing engine product.
units.search: Search API live since March. Next is a Contents API eval to pull full product pages.
units.incumbent: Acme Search for search. Their own scraper for pages.
units.gate: Contents API eval starts after the Research API deal signs.

units.name: Northwind EU
units.what: The same products sold to clients in Europe. Run from their Dublin office.
units.search: Would use the Search API for EU retail data.
units.gate: Needs EU data residency. Not on our roadmap until Q2 2027.

units.name: Marketing Analytics
units.what: Measures brand mentions and ad reach for clients.
units.search: Possible fit for news and web mentions through the Search API.

next_action.then: Sam asks Elena for a 20-minute intro to Grace before signature. Priya shares the prompt fix that lifts long-question accuracy.

thesis.paragraph: Northwind already trusts us with their pricing engine. **The Research API saves each analyst about 3.5 hours per report.** With 60 analysts, that is the case Elena will take to the CFO. We win if we **finish security fast, meet Grace before signature, and close the accuracy gap on long questions.**

priorities.text: Leo finishes the last 23 answers. Dana checks the retention answers.

priorities.head: Meet Grace Kim.
priorities.text: Ask Elena for a short intro. Bring the time-saved math, not a demo.

priorities.head: Close the accuracy gap.
priorities.text: Priya ships the long-question prompt fix and reruns the test set before go-live.

priorities.head: Line up the next unit.
priorities.text: Plan the Contents API eval with Jordan so it starts the week after signature.
